name: Individual Person 8
definition: Human entity, as distinguished from a corporate entity (which is sometimes referred to as an 'artificial person').

Name.name: Name
Name.definition: Name by which a party is known and which is usually used to identify that party.

NamePrefix.name: Name Prefix
NamePrefix.definition: Specifies the terms used to formally address a person.

NameSuffix.name: Name Suffix
NameSuffix.definition: Additional information about a person that follows a person's name, for example, qualification such as Doctor of Philosophy (PhD).

Gender.name: Gender
Gender.definition: Specifies the gender of the person.

BirthDate.name: Birth Date
BirthDate.definition: Date on which a person is born.

SocialSecurityNumber.name: Social Security Number
SocialSecurityNumber.definition: Number assigned by a social security agency.

SocialSecurityNumberGuideline.definition: The UK Insurance Number must be indicated without spaces.
